---
title: "Bayesian parameter estimation of the algae-rotifer system"
output: html_notebook
---

This is note book provides the R codes for estimating the parameter values in the Lotka-Volterra model
by fitting it to the experimental data.

## Estimating green algae parameters


```{r logistic growth of green algae}
library(rstan)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(latex2exp)
library(bayesplot)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)
library(bayesplot)

options(mc.cores = parallel::detectCores())
rstan_options(auto_write = TRUE)

Plot_Logistic_bayes_shifted <- function(df1, prey, gname1, gname2,  sname, scaling_parm = 1e8) {
  
  data <- df1[df1$Species == prey, ]
  data$Mean <- data$Mean / scaling_parm
  data <- data[order(data$Day, data$Sample), ]

  
  # time
  ts <- sort(unique(data$Day[data$Day > 0]))
  t0 <- 0.0
  T <- length(ts)
  
  # replicate
  n_samples <- length(unique(data$Sample))
  
  # itni
  y0 <- data[data$Day == 0, ]$Mean
  
  # observation Day>0
  z <- t(matrix(data[data$Day > 0, ]$Mean, nrow = n_samples))
  
  # NaCl condition
  NaCl_vec <- as.integer(data[data$Day == 0, ]$NaCl > 0)

  # Stan
  fit <- stan(
    file = "algae_logistic_shift.stan",
    data = list(
      T = T,
      n_samples = n_samples,
      y0 = y0,
      z = z,
      t0 = t0,
      ts = ts,
      NaCl = NaCl_vec
    ),
    seed = 1,
    chains = 4,
    iter = 50000,
    warmup = 5000,
    control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95),
    verbose=FALSE
  )

  print(fit, pars = c("mu_r", "delta_r", "mu_K", "delta_K"), probs = c(.05, .5, .95))
  saveRDS(fit, file = sname)

  # psoterior
  posterior <- as.data.frame(fit)
  
  # r and K under salinity stress
  posterior$mu_r_plus_delta_r <- posterior$mu_r + posterior$delta_r
  posterior$mu_K_plus_delta_K <- posterior$mu_K + posterior$delta_K
  
  # plot
  g_r=mcmc_areas(
    posterior,
    pars = c("mu_r", "mu_r_plus_delta_r"),
    prob = 0.95,
    point_est = "median"
  ) +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = c("w/o salt", "w/ salt")) +
    xlab("Intrinsic growth rate (r)") +
    theme_classic()+theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15, angle=90,  hjust = -.02),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size=0),
    legend.position = "none"
  )


  g_K <-mcmc_areas(
    posterior,
    pars = c("mu_K", "mu_K_plus_delta_K"),
    prob = 0.95,
    point_est = "median"
  ) +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = c("w/o salt", "w/ salt")) +
    xlab(bquote("Carrying capacity (K) × 10"^.(log10(scaling_parm)))) +
    theme_classic()+theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15, angle=90, hjust = -.02),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size=0),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
  
  g_delta <- mcmc_areas(
    posterior,
    pars = c("delta_r", "delta_K"),
    prob = 0.95,
    point_est = "median"
  ) +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = c("r", "K")) +
    xlab("Parameter shift w/ salt") +
    theme_classic()+theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18, angle=90, hjust = -.02),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size=0),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
  
  g_parm=(g_r+g_K)/g_delta+ plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'A') &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 24))
  ggsave(gname1)

# 
xdata <- data.frame(
  cells = matrix(z * scaling_parm, ncol = 1),  # スケールを戻す
  sample = rep(1:n_samples, each = T),
  time = rep(ts, n_samples)
)

pred_df <- as.data.frame(fit, pars = "z_pred") %>%
  tidyr::gather(factor_key = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(key) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(
    lb = quantile(value, probs = 0.025) * scaling_parm,
    median = quantile(value, probs = 0.5) * scaling_parm,
    ub = quantile(value, probs = 0.975) * scaling_parm
  ) %>%
  dplyr::bind_cols(xdata)

pred_add <- data.frame(
  key = paste0("z_pred[0,", 1:n_samples, "]"),
  lb = y0 * scaling_parm,
  median = y0 * scaling_parm,
  ub = y0 * scaling_parm,
  cells = y0 * scaling_parm,
  sample = 1:n_samples,
  time = 0
)

pred_df <- rbind(pred_add, pred_df)

# 
g <- ggplot(pred_df, aes(x = time, y = cells, color = as.factor(sample))) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(x = "Time (day)", y = TeX("Green algae (/ml)")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = median)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lb, ymax = ub), alpha = 0.1) +
  facet_wrap(~factor(sample)) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = trans_format("log10", math_format(10^.x))) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=c(0, 3, 6, 9))+
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
ggsave(gname2)

  return(fit)
}


df_prey=read.csv('Prey _2024_Feb.csv') # mono-culture without salt
df_prey$NaCl=0
df_prey_salt=read.csv('Prey _2024_Feb - W__salt.csv') # mono-culture witht salt
df_prey_salt$NaCl=0.06
df1=rbind(df_prey, df_prey_salt)
df1=df1[df1$Day<10, ]#Because some data lack at day 10, we only use data until day 9

cv_mono <- Plot_Logistic_bayes_shifted(df1, prey = 'C. vulgaris', gname1 = "PreyDynamics_Cv_parameter.png", 
                                       gname2 = "PreyDynamics_Cv_dynamics.png", sname="CV_mono_fit.rds",
                                       scaling_parm = 1e8)
cs_mono <- Plot_Logistic_bayes_shifted(df1, prey = 'C.sphaeroides', gname1 = "PreyDynamics_Cs_parameter.png", 
                                       gname2 = "PreyDynamics_Cs_dynamics.png", sname="Cs_mono_fit.rds",
                                       scaling_parm =1e7)
```

# Fitting to prey-predator dynamics (Cv)

Model 1: mortality rate may change
```{r Bayesian model of rotifer-CV new version 1}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)
library(loo)
library(rstan)

# Read the CSV file
df <- read.csv("Prey_predator_experiment.csv")
df <- df[df$Prey=='C. vulgaris',]
df$Sample <- as.character(df$Sample)

# Filter only Day >= 0
df <- df %>% filter(Day >= 0)

# Identify unique samples and time points
samples <- unique(df$Sample)
ts <- sort(unique(df$Day))[-1]
T <- length(ts)
N <- length(samples)

# Initialize containers
y0 <- matrix(NA, nrow=N, ncol=2)
y <- array(NA, dim=c(N, T, 2))
salt_vec <- numeric(N)
prey_type_vec <- numeric(N)

# Map prey types to numeric
prey_map <- setNames(1:2, c("C. vulgaris", "C.sphaeroides"))

# Loop through each sample
# Construct y0 and y using df[df$Sample == i, ]
scale_prey=c(1e8, 1e7)
scale_pred=1e3
avoid_zero=1e0
for (i in seq_along(samples)) {
  sub <- df[df$Sample == samples[i], ]
  prey <- sub$Prey[1]
  salt <- sub$NaCl[1]

  prey_type_vec[i] <- ifelse(prey == "C. vulgaris", 1, 2)
  salt_vec[i] <- ifelse(salt == 0, 1, 2)

  y0[i, ] <- c(sub[sub$Day == 0, ]$Algae.Mean[1]/scale_prey[prey_type_vec[1]],
               (sub[sub$Day == 0, ]$Predator.count[1]+avoid_zero)/scale_pred)

  prey_obs <- sub[sub$Day > 0, ]$Algae.Mean/scale_prey[prey_type_vec[1]]
  pred_obs <-( sub[sub$Day > 0, ]$Predator.count+avoid_zero)/scale_pred
  y[i, , ] <- cbind(prey_obs, pred_obs)
}

# Use the median value of the posterior distribution for r and K
cv_mono=readRDS("Cv_mono_fit.rds")
cv_data=as.data.frame(cv_mono)


r <- c(median(cv_data$mu_r), median(cv_data$mu_r)+median(cv_data$delta_r))
K <- c(median(cv_data$mu_K), median(cv_data$mu_K)+median(cv_data$delta_K))

# Prepare data list for Stan
stan_data <- list(
  N = N,
  T = T,
  salt = salt_vec,
  prey_type = prey_type_vec,
  y0 = y0,
  y = y,
  ts = ts,
  r = r,
  K = K
)

# Run Stan model
fit1 <- stan(
  file = "predator_prey_model2_new1.stan",
  data = stan_data,
  seed = 1,
  chains = 4,
  iter = 50000,
  warmup =5000,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.9)
)
 
 # Save fit object
 saveRDS(fit1, file = "predator_prey_Cv_fit_new1.rds")
 log_lik1 = extract_log_lik(fit1)
 waic1= waic(log_lik1) # test


```

```{r Bayesian model of rotifer-CV new version 7}

# Read the CSV file
df <- read.csv("Prey_predator_experiment.csv")
df <- df[df$Prey=='C. vulgaris',]
df$Sample <- as.character(df$Sample)

# Filter only Day >= 0
df <- df %>% filter(Day >= 0)

# Identify unique samples and time points
samples <- unique(df$Sample)
ts <- sort(unique(df$Day))[-1]
T <- length(ts)
N <- length(samples)

# Initialize containers
y0 <- matrix(NA, nrow=N, ncol=2)
y <- array(NA, dim=c(N, T, 2))
salt_vec <- numeric(N)
prey_type_vec <- numeric(N)

# Map prey types to numeric
prey_map <- setNames(1:2, c("C. vulgaris", "C.sphaeroides"))

# Loop through each sample
# Construct y0 and y using df[df$Sample == i, ]
scale_prey=c(1e8, 1e7)
scale_pred=1e3
avoid_zero=1e0
for (i in seq_along(samples)) {
  sub <- df[df$Sample == samples[i], ]
  prey <- sub$Prey[1]
  salt <- sub$NaCl[1]

  prey_type_vec[i] <- ifelse(prey == "C. vulgaris", 1, 2)
  salt_vec[i] <- ifelse(salt == 0, 1, 2)

  y0[i, ] <- c(sub[sub$Day == 0, ]$Algae.Mean[1]/scale_prey[prey_type_vec[1]],
               (sub[sub$Day == 0, ]$Predator.count[1]+avoid_zero)/scale_pred)

  prey_obs <- sub[sub$Day > 0, ]$Algae.Mean/scale_prey[prey_type_vec[1]]
  pred_obs <-( sub[sub$Day > 0, ]$Predator.count+avoid_zero)/scale_pred
  y[i, , ] <- cbind(prey_obs, pred_obs)
}

# Use the median value of the posterior distribution for r and K
cv_mono=readRDS("Cv_mono_fit.rds")

K <- c(median(cv_data$mu_K), median(cv_data$mu_K)+median(cv_data$delta_K))

# Prepare data list for Stan

  N = N,
  T = T,
  salt = salt_vec,

  y = y,
  ts = ts,
  r = r,
  K = K
)

# Run Stan model

)
 
 # Save fit object
 saveRDS(fit7, file = "predator_prey_Cv_fit_new7.rds")
```

```{r Model comparison with rotifer-Cv new}
get_ci <- function(x){
  q <- quantile(
    x,
    probs = c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  sprintf(
    "%.3f [%.3f, %.3f]",
    q[2], q[1], q[3]
  )
}
```

```{r plotting the dynamics from model 4}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(deSolve)

LV=function(t, x, parm){
  with(as.list(c(x, parm)),{
    dx1=r*x1*(1-x1/K)-a*x1*x2
    dx2=x2*(b*a*x1-m)
    return(list(c(dx1, dx2)))
  })
}

Dynamics_Plot_Cv=function(fit, salt_id, gname){
  # Plot the Cv fitting
  prey="C. vulgaris"
  if(salt_id==1){
    salt=0
  }else{
    salt=0.06
  }
  #Posterior sampling
  sample_n=1000
  posterior_samples=rstan::extract(fit)
 df <- read.csv("Prey_predator_experiment.csv")
 scale_prey=1e8
 scale_pred=1e3
 # Use the median value of the posterior distribution for r and K
cv_mono=readRDS("Cv_mono_fit.rds")
cv_data=as.data.frame(cv_mono)


r <- c(median(cv_data$mu_r), median(cv_data$mu_r)+median(cv_data$delta_r))
K <- c(median(cv_data$mu_K), median(cv_data$mu_K)+median(cv_data$delta_K))
  
  a_sample = exp(sample(posterior_samples$log_a[, salt_id], sample_n))
  c_sample = sample(posterior_samples$c_raw[, salt_id], sample_n)
  m_sample = exp(sample(posterior_samples$log_m[, salt_id], sample_n))
  
  df_sub=df[df$Prey== prey  & df$NaCl==salt, ]
  init=c(x1=mean(df_sub[df_sub$Day==0,]$Algae.Mean/scale_prey),
           x2=mean(df_sub[df_sub$Day==0,]$Predator.count/scale_pred)
  )
    #Posterior sampling
    for(i in 1:sample_n){
      out=ode(y=init,times=unique(df_sub$Day),func=LV,
              parm=list(r=r[salt_id], K=K[salt_id], 
                        a=a_sample[i], b=c_sample[i],  m=m_sample[i]
                        ))
      outdf_add=data.frame(out)
      outdf_add$x1=outdf_add$x1*scale_prey[1]
      outdf_add$x2=outdf_add$x2*scale_pred
      outdf_add$Sample=sprintf('Simulation%d',i)
      if (i==1){
        outdf=outdf_add
      }else{
        outdf=rbind(outdf, outdf_add)
      }
    }
    df_exp=data.frame(time=df_sub$Day, x1=df_sub$Algae.Mean, 
                      x2=df_sub$Predator.count, Sample=df_sub$Sample)
    g1=ggplot(df_exp, aes(x=time, y=x1, color=Sample))+geom_line(linewidth=2)+geom_point(size=3)+
      xlab('Time (day)')+ylab("Green algae (/ml)")+
      scale_x_continuous(breaks=c(0,3,6,9))+
      scale_y_log10(labels = trans_format("log10", math_format(10^.x)), breaks=c(10^6, 10^7, 10^8)) +
      theme_classic()+
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
            axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
            axis.title.x = element_text(size = 18),
            axis.title.y = element_text(size=18),
            legend.position= 'none')+
      geom_line(data=outdf, aes(x=time, y=x1,group=Sample), alpha=0.05, color='grey')
    g2=ggplot(df_exp, aes(x=time, y=x2, color=Sample))+geom_line(linewidth=2)+geom_point(size=3)+
      xlab('Time (day)')+ylab(TeX(' Rotifers  (/ml)'))+
      scale_x_continuous(breaks=c(0,3,6,9))+
       scale_y_log10(labels = trans_format("log10", math_format(10^.x)), breaks=c(1, 10^1, 10^2, 10^3)) +
      theme_classic()+
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
            axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
            axis.title.x = element_text(size = 18),
            axis.title.y = element_text(size=18),
            legend.position= 'none')+
      geom_line(data=outdf, aes(x=time, y=x2,group=Sample), alpha=0.05, color='grey')
  
    g=g1+g2+plot_layout(ncol = 2)+plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'A')& theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 24))
    ggsave(gname)
}

fit=readRDS("predator_prey_Cv_fit_new4.rds")
```

```{r plotting the empirical dynamics and the posterior: Cs-rotifer}
    salt=0
  }else{
    salt=0.06
  }
  #Posterior sampling
  sample_n=1000
  posterior_samples=rstan::extract(fit)
 df <- read.csv("Prey_predator_experiment.csv")
 scale_prey=1e7
 scale_pred=1e3
 # Use the median value of the posterior distribution for r and K
cs_mono=readRDS("Cs_mono_fit.rds")
cs_data=as.data.frame(cs_mono)


r <- c(median(cs_data$mu_r), median(cs_data$mu_r)+median(cs_data$delta_r))
K <- c(median(cs_data$mu_K), median(cs_data$mu_K)+median(cs_data$delta_K))
  

a_sample = sample(posterior_samples$a_row[, salt_id], sample_n) 
  c_sample = sample(posterior_samples$c_raw, sample_n)
  m_sample = exp(sample(posterior_samples$log_m, sample_n))
  
  df_sub=df[df$Prey== prey  & df$NaCl==salt, ]
  init=c(x1=mean(df_sub[df_sub$Day==0,]$Algae.Mean/scale_prey),
           x2=mean(df_sub[df_sub$Day==0,]$Predator.count/scale_pred)
  )
    #Posterior sampling
    for(i in 1:sample_n){
      out=ode(y=init,times=unique(df_sub$Day),func=LV,
              parm=list(r=r[salt_id], K=K[salt_id], 
                        a=a_sample[i], b=c_sample[i],  m=m_sample[i]
                        ))
      outdf_add=data.frame(out)
      outdf_add$x1=outdf_add$x1*scale_prey[1]
      outdf_add$x2=outdf_add$x2*scale_pred
      outdf_add$Sample=sprintf('Simulation%d',i)
      if (i==1){
        outdf=outdf_add
      }else{
        outdf=rbind(outdf, outdf_add)
      }
    }
    df_exp=data.frame(time=df_sub$Day, x1=df_sub$Algae.Mean, 
                      x2=df_sub$Predator.count, Sample=df_sub$Sample)
    g1=ggplot(df_exp, aes(x=time, y=x1, color=Sample))+geom_line(linewidth=2)+geom_point(size=3)+
      xlab('Time (day)')+ylab("Green algae (/ml)")+
      scale_x_continuous(breaks=c(0,3,6,9))+
      scale_y_log10(labels = trans_format("log10", math_format(10^.x)), breaks=c(10^6, 10^7, 10^8)) +
      theme_classic()+
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
            axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
            axis.title.x = element_text(size = 18),
            axis.title.y = element_text(size=18),
            legend.position= 'none')+
      geom_line(data=outdf, aes(x=time, y=x1,group=Sample), alpha=0.05, color='grey')
    g2=ggplot(df_exp, aes(x=time, y=x2, color=Sample))+geom_line(linewidth=2)+geom_point(size=3)+
      xlab('Time (day)')+ylab(TeX(' Rotifers  (/ml)'))+
      scale_x_continuous(breaks=c(0,3,6,9))+
       scale_y_log10(labels = trans_format("log10", math_format(10^.x)), breaks=c(1, 10^1, 10^2, 10^3)) +
      theme_classic()+
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
            axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
            axis.title.x = element_text(size = 18),
            axis.title.y = element_text(size=18),
            legend.position= 'none')+
      geom_line(data=outdf, aes(x=time, y=x2,group=Sample), alpha=0.05, color='grey')
  
    g=g1+g2+plot_layout(ncol = 2)+plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'A')& theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 24))
    ggsave(gname)
```
